```{r}
############################################################
## Libraries
############################################################
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(vcfR)
library(snpStats)
library(LDheatmap)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}
############################################################
## Parameters
############################################################
chrM <- "chr2"
SNP  <- 1461736473
left <- 1461736473
right <- 1461746725
min_group_size <- 10
```


```{r}
############################################################
## =========================================================
## PART A — VCF (LD HEATMAPS ONLY)
## =========================================================
############################################################

vcf <- read.vcfR(
  "../../../../../../../files_too_heavy_for_git/pisum/vfaba_apisum_n6.filtered_imputed_maf.vcf.hedin2.vcf"
)

fix <- getFIX(vcf)

convertToNumeric <- function(x) {
  gdat <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(x), ncol = ncol(x))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(x))) {
      alleles <- unlist(strsplit(x[i, j], "[|/]"))
      gdat[i, j] <- sum(as.numeric(alleles))
    }
  }
  rownames(gdat) <- rownames(x)
  colnames(gdat) <- colnames(x)
  gdat
}

## ---- LD heatmap: initial SNP window ----
keep_init <- fix[, "CHROM"] == chrM &
  as.numeric(fix[, "POS"]) >= left &
  as.numeric(fix[, "POS"]) <= right

vcf_init <- vcf[keep_init, ]
gt_init <- t(vcf_init@gt[, -1])
gdat_init <- convertToNumeric(gt_init)

snp_pos_init <- as.numeric(vcf_init@fix[, "POS"])
snp_ids_init <- paste0(chrM, "_", snp_pos_init)

colnames(gdat_init) <- snp_ids_init
rownames(gdat_init) <- rownames(gt_init)

gdat_init <- as(gdat_init, "SnpMatrix")

n_colors <- 100
color_list <- c("black","darkred","red","orange","yellow","white")
custom_colors <- colorRampPalette(color_list)(n_colors)
png("LD_heatmap_01_initial_window.png", 1200, 1200, res = 150)
LDheatmap(gdat_init, color = custom_colors, genetic.distances = snp_pos_init, add.map=TRUE)
dev.off()
```


```{r}
############################################################
## =========================================================
## PART B — TSV (GENOTYPES, WINDOW LOGIC, PHEATMAPS)
## =========================================================
############################################################

df <- fread(
  "../../../../../../../files_too_heavy_for_git/pisum/vfaba_apisum_n6.filtered_imputed_maf.vcf.hedin2.tsv"
)

df_filtered <- df %>%
  separate(snp_id, into = c("chromosome", "position"), sep = "_", convert = TRUE) %>%
  filter(chromosome == chrM, position >= left, position <= right) %>%
  mutate(snp_id = paste0(chromosome, "_", position))

snp_ids_all <- df_filtered$snp_id

df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
  select(-chromosome, -position, -snp_id)

setnames(df_filtered, names(df_filtered), sub("_.*$", "", names(df_filtered)))

geno_to_num <- function(g) {
  if (g %in% c("0|0", "0/0")) 0 else if (g %in% c("1|1", "1/1")) 2 else 1
}

df_num <- as.data.frame(lapply(df_filtered, function(x) sapply(x, geno_to_num)))
df_num_t_all <- t(df_num)
rownames(df_num_t_all) <- colnames(df_filtered)
colnames(df_num_t_all) <- snp_ids_all

```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1. Hierarchical clustering on genotypes
# -----------------------------
d <- dist(df_num_t_all, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(d, method = "average")
groups <- cutree(hc, k = 6)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Create cluster table
# -----------------------------
cluster_table <- data.frame(
  ivip = names(groups),
  Group = groups, row.names = NULL
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Reorder dataframe by cluster order for TSV
# -----------------------------
ordered_genotypes <- hc$labels[hc$order]
df_ordered <- df_num_t_all[ordered_genotypes, ]
df_ordered <- cbind(Genotype = rownames(df_ordered), df_ordered)

# -----------------------------
# 3. Load metadata and prepare annotations
# -----------------------------
genet_cluster <- read.table("../../../../../00.info/11.infos_genotypes/metadata.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
colnames(genet_cluster) <- c("ivip", "cluster")

emmeans <- read.csv("../../../01_phenotipic_analysis/02.ajusted_means/pisum/emmeans_pisum_6.csv")

annotation <- merge(emmeans,genet_cluster, by = "ivip", all.x = TRUE)


# -----------------------------
# 4. Prepare annotation for pheatmap
# -----------------------------
# Ensure rownames match df_num_t
rownames(annotation) <- annotation$ivip
annotation$ivip <- NULL

# Ensure types
annotation$cluster <- as.factor(annotation$cluster)
annotation$emmean <- as.numeric(annotation$emmean)

# Colors
cluster_colors <- setNames(brewer.pal(length(levels(annotation$cluster)), "Set3"),
                           levels(annotation$cluster))
emmean_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "black"))(100)

summary(annotation)
annotation_colors <- list(
  cluster = cluster_colors,
  emmean = emmean_colors
)




# -----------------------------
# 5. Generate heatmap PNG
# -----------------------------
pheatmap(df_num_t_all,
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
         clustering_method = "average",
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         annotation_row = annotation,
         annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
         main = "Genotype similarity with clusters & emmean",
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         filename = "vfaba.whole_segment.heatmap_clusters_emmean.png",
         width = 10,
         height = 12)



## ---- pheatmap 1: initial SNP window ----
pheatmap(
  df_num_t_all,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  annotation_row = annotation,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  main = "Initial SNP window",
  filename = "heatmap_01_initial_snps.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 12
)



############################################################
## Iterative SNP window reduction
############################################################

target_snp <- paste0(chrM, "_", SNP)
current_snps <- colnames(df_num_t_all)

repeat {
  if (length(current_snps) <= 1) break

  df_window <- df_num_t_all[, current_snps, drop = FALSE]
  hap <- apply(df_window, 1, paste, collapse = "_")

  groups <- data.frame(
    genotype = rownames(df_window),
    haplotype = hap
  ) %>%
    group_by(haplotype) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      has_2 = any(df_window[genotype, target_snp] == 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n >= min_group_size)

  if (nrow(groups) >= 2 && any(groups$has_2)) break

  current_snps <- current_snps[-length(current_snps)]
}

df_num_t_window <- df_num_t_all[, current_snps, drop = FALSE]

############################################################
## =========================================================
## PART C — VCF (LD HEATMAP  WINDOW)
## =========================================================
############################################################

final_pos <- as.numeric(sub(".*_", "", current_snps))
keep_final <- fix[, "CHROM"] == chrM &
  as.numeric(fix[, "POS"]) %in% final_pos

vcf_final <- vcf[keep_final, ]
gt_final <- t(vcf_final@gt[, -1])
gdat_final <- convertToNumeric(gt_final)

snp_ids_final <- paste0(chrM, "_", final_pos)
colnames(gdat_final) <- snp_ids_final
rownames(gdat_final) <- rownames(gt_final)
gdat_final <- as(gdat_final, "SnpMatrix")
current_snps
png("LD_heatmap_02_output_window.png", 1200, 1200, res = 150)
LDheatmap(gdat_final, color = custom_colors, genetic.distances = final_pos, add.map=TRUE)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
convertToNumeric <- function(x){
  gdat <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(x), ncol = ncol(x))
  for (m in 1:nrow(x)){
    for (n in 1:ncol(x)){
      alleles <- unlist(strsplit(x[m,n], "[|/]"))
      gdat[m,n] <- sum(as.numeric(alleles))
    }

  rownames(gdat) <- rownames(x)
  colnames(gdat) <- colnames(x)
```

2.  creation of the haplotypes

load and prepare the dataset

```{r}
#| echo: false
# -----------------------------
# 1. Load the dataset
# -----------------------------

df <- fread("../../../../../../../files_too_heavy_for_git/pisum/vfaba_apisum_n6.filtered_imputed_maf.vcf.hedin2.tsv")



# -----------------------------
# 2. Split SNP ID, filter, and rebuild SNP ID
# -----------------------------
df_filtered <- df %>%
  separate(
    col = snp_id,
    into = c("chromosome", "position"),
    sep = "_",
    convert = TRUE
  ) %>%
  filter(
    chromosome == chrM,
    position >= left,
    position <= right
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    snp_id = paste0(chromosome, "_", position)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 3. Add reference genome column first
# -----------------------------
df_filtered$hedin <- "0|0"

df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
  relocate(hedin, .before = everything())

# -----------------------------
# 4. Store SNP IDs and drop metadata
# -----------------------------
snp_ids <- df_filtered$snp_id

df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
  select(-chromosome, -position, -snp_id)

# Clean sample names
setnames(
  df_filtered,
  old = names(df_filtered),
  new = sub("_.*$", "", names(df_filtered))
)

# -----------------------------
# 5. Convert genotype strings to numeric
# -----------------------------
geno_to_num <- function(g) {
  if (g %in% c("0|0", "0/0")) return(0)
  else if (g %in% c("1|1", "1/1")) return(2)
  else return(1)
}

df_num <- as.data.frame(
  lapply(df_filtered, function(col) sapply(col, geno_to_num))
)

# -----------------------------
# 6. Transpose: genotypes as rows, SNPs as columns
# -----------------------------
df_num_t <- t(df_num)

rownames(df_num_t) <- colnames(df_filtered)
colnames(df_num_t) <- snp_ids

```

set up the parameters for the haplotype clustering


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(tibble)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Create haplotype strings
# -----------------------------
haplotypes <- apply(df_num_t, 1, paste, collapse = "_")

df_groups <- data.frame(
  ivip = rownames(df_num_t),
  haplotype = haplotypes
)

# -----------------------------
# 2. Count group sizes and keep only groups with >=10
# -----------------------------
min_group_size <- 10
df_genotype_groups <- df_groups %>%
  group_by(haplotype) %>%
  mutate(group_size = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(group_size >= min_group_size) %>%
  mutate(group_id = as.integer(factor(haplotype))) %>%
  select(ivip, group_id)

# -----------------------------
# 3. Merge with emmean and genet_cluster
# -----------------------------
annotation <- df_genotype_groups %>%
  left_join(genet_cluster, by = "ivip") %>%
  left_join(emmeans, by = "ivip") %>%
  column_to_rownames("ivip")  # rownames must match df_num_t

# Ensure types
annotation$group_id <- as.factor(annotation$group_id)
annotation$cluster <- as.factor(annotation$cluster)
annotation$emmeans <- as.numeric(annotation$emmean)

# -----------------------------
# 4. Subset df_num_t to only selected ivip
# -----------------------------
df_num_t_selected <- df_num_t[rownames(annotation), , drop = FALSE]

# -----------------------------
# 5. Define colors for pheatmap
# -----------------------------
annotation_colors <- list(
  group_id = setNames(brewer.pal(length(levels(annotation$group_id)), "Set2"),
                      levels(annotation$group_id)),
  cluster = setNames(brewer.pal(length(levels(annotation$cluster)), "Set3"),
                     levels(annotation$cluster)),
  emmean = colorRampPalette(c("white","black"))(100)
)

# -----------------------------
# 6. Plot pheatmap
# -----------------------------
pheatmap(
  df_num_t_selected,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_row = annotation[, c("group_id", "cluster", "emmean")],
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  main = "Genotypes grouped by haplotype with emmean & cluster",
  filename = "haplotype_groups_heatmap.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 12
)


```

3.  Effect of the haplotype in the GWAS dataset

Load and merge the phenotypic data with the haplotype information

```{r}
pheno <-read.csv("../../../../01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/01.dataset_filtering/02_A.pisum/final filters/acyrthosiphon_pisum_filtered_6.csv") 

colnames(df_genotype_groups)[1]<-"ivip"
merged_df <- merge(pheno, df_genotype_groups, by = "ivip", all.x = TRUE)
merged_df$group_id <- as.factor(merged_df$group_id)
summary(merged_df)

```

create the model and do the post hoc test

```{r}

model <- lm(larvae_total_number ~ group_id + session/block,data = merged_df) 
anova(model)

model_emmean <- lmer(larvae_total_number ~ group_id + (1 | session/block), data = merged_df)


# Estimated marginal means

emm <- emmeans(model_emmean, ~ group_id)

# Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons

cld <- multcomp::cld(emm, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey")

# View letters

cld

png( filename = "boxplot_haplotype_comparison_chr2_1461736473.png", width = 2000, height = 1800, res = 300 )

# Basic boxplot using base R

boxplot(larvae_total_number ~ group_id, data = merged_df, main = "Boxplot of Larvae Total Number by Group", xlab = "Group", ylab = "Larvae Total Number", col = "grey")

stripchart(larvae_total_number ~ group_id, data = merged_df, vertical = TRUE, method = "jitter", pch = 14, col = "black", add = TRUE)
```
